title: The Asking for Help with the Jar Lid
youtube_title: The Asking for Help with the Jar Lid | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small voice used at the right moment.
summary: At a small school room with a low stage edge, Niko feels shy about a jar lid that would not turn. Instead of pretending not to care, Niko tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Mama stays kind and does not push for a show.
